- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — model tends to overshoot.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.15) — model is overly conservative.
- Lagged price spikes are often overpredicted — model reacts too quickly to recent highs.
- Mean reversion bias: model holds onto overbought levels longer than actual price retracements.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model consistently underestimates upward momentum after strong sentiment shifts.
- When sentiment turns positive after a dip, model fails to capture the full rally — underreacts to sentiment reversal.
- Avoid smoothing out sharp declines — model tends to flatten them, missing true bottoming.
- Overshoots after sentiment spikes — especially when sentiment > 0.20 — model overcorrects downward.
